source.label: Marvel.com Marvel Universe wiki: Sentry (Robert Reynolds) (archived 12 April 2016)

powerOrigins.detail: Drank the Golden Sentry Serum, which shifted his molecules an instant ahead in time and gave him the power of a million exploding suns.

abilities.name: Superhuman strength
abilities.detail: Lifts far beyond 100 tons; tore Carnage and Ares apart and has rivalled the Hulk, though his strength swings with his mental state.

abilities.name: Molecular manipulation
abilities.detail: Can reshape matter at the molecular level; rebuilt his own body and beat the Molecule Man with this power.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Dark Avengers Vol 1 12

abilities.name: Regeneration and immortality
abilities.detail: Heals from almost anything, even being dispersed into molecules, and neither he nor the Void stays dead.

abilities.name: Nigh-invulnerability
abilities.detail: Shrugs off attacks that would destroy almost any other being.

abilities.name: Flight and speed
abilities.detail: Flies far past Mach 10 and has reached the Sun and back in moments; he can catch bullets.

abilities.name: Energy and light
abilities.detail: Fires energy blasts and generates and shapes light, from a blinding pulse to constructs that block attacks.

abilities.name: Teleportation
abilities.detail: Can teleport himself from place to place.

feats.text: During the siege of Asgard, shrugged off an axe wound from Ares, then tore the war god in half; the wound healed soon after.
Unleashed his full power on the Hulk across Manhattan, trading blows and pinning him down under a whirlwind of energy.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: World War Hulk Vol 1 5

feats.text: Recovered within a minute from a ray-gun shot to the face, then plunged into the Sun and regenerated.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Dark Avengers Vol 1 13

feats.text: Caught Bucky Barnes's metal-arm punch in one hand, tore the arm off and used it to swat him across the room.
With one sweep of his arms, sent a shockwave that threw Yelena, Walker and Ghost across the room.
As the Void, spread a darkness across Manhattan that pulled New Yorkers into a realm of their worst memories.
